summary: Short, steep kerb 5 m from apartment towers, with no-stopping signs.
reasons: Jarvis and Bishop Towers 5-6 m away

drivers.seclusion: Residential towers (dwellings) sit 5-6 m from the kerb along its whole length.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow campus street kerb, no pull-off; a van would stand in the lane edge.
drivers.traffic: Campus street with passing traffic and a construction site to the east.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign at the east end, No Stopping Specified Times at the west.

flags: Steep: about 12% mean grade, up to 16%
No Stopping signs 1-1.5 m from the kerb line
sun_shade: Tree canopy and tall buildings shade the kerb from the north.
cannot_judge: Times of the specified no-stopping restriction
